output.one_liner: Web scraping and data extraction platform enabling AI agents to search, scrape, and interact with websites to access live web data.

auth.notes: Supports API key (Bearer token), OAuth for apps, MCP OAuth, and WorkOS identity assertion flow. API key is primary method.

evidence.snippet: Create a key in the and send it on every request as Authorization: Bearer fc-YOUR-API-KEY
Send the user through Firecrawl's OAuth flow with resource=https://api.firecrawl.dev/

access.notes: Free tier: 1,000 credits/month refreshed monthly, no credit card required. Paid plans: Hobby ($19/month), Scale ($749/month), Enterprise (custom).

evidence.snippet: Free tier 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required
No credit card needed. Start for free
The Firecrawl API gives you programmatic access to web data
You can also call the REST API directly from any language. All SDKs support search, scrape, interact, and crawl
Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes
Connect Firecrawl to any AI agent or MCP client in minutes
Install the official Firecrawl MCP server and Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf can call Search, Scrape, Parse

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials, documented REST API with broad endpoint coverage, official SDKs, webhooks, and official MCP server enable immediate toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Firecrawl | Knowledge Infrastructure for AI Agents
Search finds relevant information on the web. Scrape turns websites into clean, structured, AI-usable data
